text: A woman with long, flowing red hair sits atop a stone ledge. She has fair skin, an hourglass build, and amber eyes. Wearing a sheer white gown cinched at the waist, she accessorizes with blue beaded necklaces and bracelets. Her pose is relaxed yet poised—knees bent, one hand resting near her chin. Behind her, ruins loom under a deep blue twilight sky. The scene suggests post-apocalyptic stillness.
